name: managing-emtala-compliance
description: Evaluates hospital compliance with EMTALA (42 U.S.C. 1395dd; 42 C.F.R. 489.24 and 489.20(l), (m), (q), (r); CMS State Operations Manual Appendix V) for one ED encounter or for a hospital program. Builds a timed record; tests whether the individual came to a dedicated emergency department or hospital property (250-yard campus, off-campus departments, ambulances); checks the medical screening examination (MSE) by qualified medical personnel designated in governing-body-approved bylaws, triage versus MSE, registration or insurance delay, LWBS; stabilization versus "stable for transfer", labor and false labor, psychiatric boarding, on-call response, inpatient admission; transfer certification, acceptance, records and transport; recipient hospital duties and the 72-hour report; signage, central log and on-call list; Appendix V tags and current penalty figures. Use for EMTALA audits, complaint or survey response, patient dumping or transfer review. Drafts for compliance and counsel review; never alters records.
